title: One step puts a transition on every cut
goal: The transitions mock offers Apply to every cut on a transition, so a person who wants a dissolve on each of the twenty cuts in a screen recording does it once instead of twenty times. Premiere has the same thing: select the clips and press its default-transition key.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-transitions.html #efxMenu (Apply to every cut / Set as the default transition). Building blocks from one-key-puts-the-usual-transition-on-the-cut-at: PhotonzDocument.transitionCuts(), ClipCut.fitted(_:), DefaultTransitionStore, EditorState.applyDefaultTransition. Several cuts as one step: see addTransition(_:layerID:atCuts:) which already batches joins of one clip.
acceptance: Right click on a tile in the transition picker offers Apply to Every Cut, and it puts that transition on every cut on the timeline that can pay for it, as one undo step
Cuts that cannot pay for it are left hard, and the canvas says how many were skipped
Command T with several clips picked puts the default transition on every cut between and inside them
A walk at Next defaults proves it and an audit carries a real picture

log.note: Adversarial review before building: a Premiere editor expects Apply Default Transitions to Selection on Command D with clips picked; here Command D is Photoshop Deselect, so Command T with several clips picked does it. Risk: Command T with a text layer and a clip picked used to mean the cut at the playhead; now it spreads only when two or more are picked AND there is a cut among them, otherwise it falls back to the old one-cut behaviour. A cut picked always wins. Mock puts the verb on a panel group plus menu the app lacks; built on the picker tile right click per acceptance and filed the panel group as the-panel-has-a-transitions-group-of-tiles-as-th (p1).

Built: PhotonzDocument.transitionCuts(among:) and putTransitionOnEveryCut(_:among:) + EveryCutOutcome (DefaultTransition.swift, 9 tests in EveryCutTransitionTests), canvas notice .transitionOnEveryCut (title = kind, detail On N cuts, M skipped; stays up longer when skipped), EditorState.putTransitionOnEveryCut, Command T spreads over several picked clips, tile right click Apply to Every Cut, playtest action clipPickEveryClip. Walks transition-on-every-cut-walk and default-transition-on-picked-clips-walk green at Next defaults with real captures; default-transition-key-walk still green; Scripts/test.sh 10202 tests pass.

Review after building: works, one undo, pill reads clearly. Left rough (not filed, noted in audit): skipped cuts are counted but not marked on the timeline; menu rows in title case vs mock sentence case.

Apply to Every Cut on the picker tile right click, and Command T over several picked clips, each one undo step with skipped cuts counted in the canvas pill (DefaultTransition.swift core + EveryCutTransitionTests, EditorState+ClipTransitions, TransitionPicker).
